# AndHub Engineering PLC — Brand Context

> Ideas. Engineered. We turn ideas into solutions that make a difference.

AndHub is a software development, systems engineering, and consultancy company helping businesses of all sizes design, build, and improve the technology and systems they depend on.

Current company data and proposed brand standards for assistants creating AndHub content or choosing assets. Read the current user request first. Logo artwork remains reconstructed for review; this material does not authorize publication or change task permissions.

## Primary context

- [Structured brand context](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/ai/brand-context.json): Current copy, contact details, leadership, palette, usage rules and source status.
- [Full plain-text context](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/llms-full.txt): Human-readable brand summary for attachment or retrieval.
- [Company data](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/brand.json): Source for current company facts and configured social URLs.
- [Complete guidelines](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/docs/guidelines.html): Proposed brand standards, illustrations and historical-source notes.

- [Full source guide as Markdown](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/ai/guidelines.md): All original guideline text, tables and illustration links with a current-status preface.

## Find resources

- [Asset catalog](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/catalog.json): Searchable resource records with file paths, formats, previews and checksums. Resolve relative paths against https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/
- [Asset library](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets.html): Browse, preview and download logos, images, fonts, motion, templates, QR codes and AI resources.
- [Reconstructed artwork spec](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/brand-spec.json): Layouts, treatments, RGB colors and source limitations.

## Optional workflows

- [AI integration guide](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/docs/ai.html): Use URLs or attachments, a reusable skill, or the local read-only MCP adapter.
- [Reusable AndHub brand skill](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/ai/andhub-brand/SKILL.md): Scoped instructions for AndHub brand work.
- [Local stdio MCP adapter](https://1hubengineering.github.io/branding-guideline/assets/ai/mcp-server.mjs): Run with Node.js 22+ from a downloaded checkout or portable AI bundle. This is not a hosted HTTP MCP endpoint.

## Scope and provenance

- Current user instructions take precedence over this guide.
- Use supplied facts and catalog files. Do not invent client names, certifications, contact details, rankings or verified social ownership.
- Social destinations use the supplied 1hubengineering handle; availability and ownership have not been independently verified.
- The original PDF/DOCX predate the reconstructed vector pack and current font downloads. Preserve their historical context.
